question: Among large-cap 4%-down days (short side), does composite RS rank (rs) grade the short trade -- do LOW-rs (laggard) names fall harder than high-rs names? Expect lower rs=better short, i.e. top-minus-bottom effect negative.
plain: When large caps break down, do the weakest-RS names keep falling the hardest, or does strong-vs-weak stop mattering once a stock is already breaking down?
